question:
(i) An alternating voltage is applied across a pure inductor of inductance $L$. Starting from $v = L\frac{di}{dt}$, obtain the expression for inductive reactance.
(ii) State the phase relation between voltage and current.
(iii) Calculate the inductive reactance of a $0.4\,\text{H}$ inductor connected to a $50\,\text{Hz}$ AC source. Take $\pi = 3.14$.

options.B:
(i) Starting with $v=L\frac{di}{dt}$ and $i=i_m\sin\omega t$, $v_m=\omega Li_m$, so $X_L=\omega L=2\pi fL$.
(ii) Voltage leads current by $\frac{\pi}{2}$, or current lags voltage by $\frac{\pi}{2}$.
(iii) $X_L=2\times3.14\times50\times0.4=125.6\,\Omega$.
options.C:
(i) $X_L=\omega C$.
(ii) Voltage and current are in phase.
(iii) $X_L=157\,\Omega$.
